test_title: PYST 30: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 26th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option that is related to the third letter-cluster in the same way as the second letter-cluster is related to the first letter-cluster.

CGRT : DJWA :: XUKM : ?
solution:
The table is alphabets place value:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/259d8630a9ac11653540776fb8c878efe7c7e39d2fafd27847036c083bb6c14d.png] 

The pattern followed here is:

CGRT : DJWA

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c702ddccebbd58b9b9731ac901980ea77e93fc24ebd4f646b5897137f8fd983d.png] 

Similarly,

**XUKM** : ?

​ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/cb0959b91dc687f72b5df7bab5808ad56281aca0222344534f41c3367fee012c.png] 

Hence, 'XUKM' is coded as "**YXPT**".
